subject: Post-call: Finex discovery + pricing / budget owner confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Collins <sara.collins@finex.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (token volumes / budget owner)

Hi Sara — great chat earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a proposal that aligns with Finex's economics.

1) Volumes you called out:
- Chat/video transcription reranker: ~200M tokens/month (peak 350M)
- Generation for analytics assistant: ~50M tokens/month
- Embeddings for search/semantic matching: 25M units/month (we price separately for embeddings)

2) Unit economics we discussed (ballpark):
- Target $/1M tokens: you mentioned finance is aiming for ~\$800–600 per 1M tokens across peak/avg workload (we can optimize this with batching & prefix caching).
- Rough estimate at our <redacted> config: \$0.95–1.10 per 1k tokens (depends on quantization & reserved capacity).

I attached a draft pricing sheet with two scenarios (on-demand hosted vs dedicated reserved capacity) plus a simple MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (MAP). Can you confirm:
- Who is the economic buyer / budget owner for this initiative (we should loop them into the pricing conversation)?
- Does Finex require finance to sign off on a PO before a POC or after?

Next steps proposed:
- I can send an initial 12-month cost model that maps your stated volumes to target $/1M buckets (low/expected/high).
- If you confirm the budget owner, I’ll schedule a short pricing walkthrough (15–20m) that includes our finance-friendly pricing options and the cost levers (batching, quantization, cache).

Thanks — I’ll hold a couple time slots for next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf, Finex-MAP.xlsx

From: Sara Collins <sara.collins@finex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Green <michael.green@finex.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (token volumes / budget owner)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side: 

- Volumes: your numbers are in the right ballpark. For planning purposes, use the 200M chat + 50M generation as the expected case and 350M peak for stress testing. Embeddings are correct.
- Budget owner: Michael Green (CFO) will own the economics and sign off on the budget. He’s cc’d.
- Finance process: Finance prefers to sign off on the full year commitment before we spin up reserved capacity; for a POC they typically approve a limited-value PO (< $25k) to start.

Michael — looping you in. Can you confirm whether we should start with a PO for the POC or if you prefer a different process?

Thanks,
Sara
Head of AI Product | Finex Analytics
sara.collins@finex.com

From: Michael Green <michael.green@finex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sara Collins <sara.collins@finex.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (token volumes / budget owner)

Marissa / Sara — thanks for the summary. Quick answers from finance perspective:

- Economic owner: I own this from the finance side; Sara is the product owner.
- Approval flow: For evaluations under $25k, we can approve a PO immediately. For anything over that we need an annual commitment and a short justification (business case) signed by me + procurement.
- Target unit economics: We’re looking for pricing that gets us under ~\$1,000 per 1M tokens for steady-state. If Redwood can show path to <\$800/1M at scale (with reserved capacity), that’s attractive.

Please send the 12-month cost model Sara mentioned and a one-pager that procurement can use for the business case.

-Michael
Michael Green
CFO | Finex Analytics
michael.green@finex.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Green <michael.green@finex.com>, Sara Collins <sara.collins@finex.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (token volumes / budget owner)

Thanks Michael — great, that’s exactly what we need. I’ll get the 12-month cost model and a procurement one-pager over by end of day today. Quick notes on approach so you know what to expect in the model:

- We’ll model three scenarios: conservative, expected, and high. Each maps your monthly token volumes to expected monthly spend and shows effective $/1M tokens.
- For reserved capacity scenario we’ll show required committed spend and the break-even month vs on-demand. We’ll call out levers: batching, KV/prefix cache, and model quantization assumptions that influence per-token cost.
- For the POC PO (<$25k) path — once you confirm value, we can run a 30-day trial on hosted capacity and then provide a dedicated reserved quote if you want to pursue cost improvements.

Action items:
- Michael: confirm PO owner for the <$25k POC (procurement contact) or I can send a sample PO to Sara to route.
- Sara: would love a 15–20m slot next week with Michael + procurement to walk through pricing. I’m available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Attaching the pricing sheet and MAP again for reference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf, Finex-MAP.xlsx
